description: Read top-level comments from one public LinkedIn post URL. Get comment text, dates, like counts and reply counts as JSON. Use it to understand questions and reactions around an announcement or discussion. Commenter identities and nested replies are not returned. Not offered on Solana: pay on Base or Polygon.

limit.description: number of comments wanted, 1 to 20 (default 5). A larger value is lowered to 20 and 0 or a negative one means the default; the quote follows the value used.

name: linkedin-comments
title: LinkedIn post comments
